title: Butterfly waving hello
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="4" ry="16" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="6" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="47" cy="41" r="1.8" fill="#663300"/>
  <circle cx="53" cy="41" r="1.8" fill="#663300"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M47 45 Q50 48 53 45" stroke="#663300" stroke-width="1.3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d="M48 37 Q44 28 40 26" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M52 37 Q56 28 60 26" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="25" r="2" fill="#ff99cc"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="25" r="2" fill="#ff99cc"/>
  <!-- left upper wing -->
  <path d="M46 50 Q20 30 14 44 Q10 56 30 60 Q42 62 46 54 Z" fill="#ff6699"/>
  <path d="M44 52 Q28 40 22 48" stroke="#ffcce0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="24" cy="46" r="3" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <!-- left lower wing -->
  <path d="M46 62 Q24 62 20 74 Q22 84 38 78 Q46 72 46 66 Z" fill="#ff9933"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <!-- right upper wing -->
  <path d="M54 50 Q80 30 86 44 Q90 56 70 60 Q58 62 54 54 Z" fill="#ff6699"/>
  <path d="M56 52 Q72 40 78 48" stroke="#ffcce0" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="46" r="3" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <!-- right lower wing -->
  <path d="M54 62 Q76 62 80 74 Q78 84 62 78 Q54 72 54 66 Z" fill="#ff9933"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#ffcc66"/>
  <!-- waving arm/leg on right -->
  <path d="M56 56 Q68 48 72 40" stroke="#ffe066" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="38" r="3.5" fill="#ffcc33"/>
  <!-- tiny floating sparkles -->
  <circle cx="14" cy="20" r="1.5" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="24" r="1.5" fill="#aaddff"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="14" r="1" fill="#aaddff"/>
</svg>
